final_message: No — the available tools (repo, tests, git, episodes handles) do not include a capability to query a hosted error-telemetry index. Only `repo` (status/orient), and other handles like git/tests/episodes are reachable, but explicitly checking for error-telemetry/observability querying capability returned "unavailable in the reachable world." These tools are limited to repository, test, git, and episode-history operations — none provide access to a hosted error-tracking/telemetry service.
